scope_note: These requirement IDs capture claims documented in profiles/waste-shipment/README.md's field-mapping table — not RFC2119 normative clauses from SPECIFICATION.md the way profiles/core-dp/requirements/core-dp-requirements.json does. A pass in this harness means 'this profile's documented field usage validates against the core v0.2.0 schemas and is internally consistent,' not full LOOP conformance (see profiles/core-dp/ for that) and not DIWASS/Waste Shipment Regulation compliance (see docs/governance/CLAIMS-AND-MATURITY.md). This profile models no DIWASS/TRACES NT API integration; waste_shipment_doc_ref is a reference a human or downstream system resolves outside LOOP.

requirements.summary: Transfer.waste_shipment_doc_ref points at a stable reference into the shipping node's own DIWASS/TRACES NT record.
requirements.rationale: This is the most direct existing mapping in this round of guidance — a dedicated top-level Transfer field, not a repurposed generic one.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: waste_shipment_doc_ref is a URI-formatted field.

requirements.contract_location: profiles/waste-shipment/README.md#field-mapping (General evidence references row; Due diligence row)
requirements.summary: traceability.document_refs and due_diligence_ref carry supporting documents (pre-consent correspondence, financial guarantee references) alongside waste_shipment_doc_ref.
requirements.rationale: These are references, not proof of access — DIWASS exposes no public lookup, so a document_refs entry is only resolvable by an authenticated, registered operator or competent authority. See docs/retention-and-evidence-guidance.md.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: document_refs is a URI array (maxItems 20); due_diligence_ref is a bounded-length string.

requirements.summary: traceability.source_operator_id and facility_id correspond to WSR's notifier/consignee and facility concepts, as asserted values LOOP does not validate against any DIWASS or national register.
requirements.rationale: profiles/waste-shipment/README.md is explicit that these are asserted, not validated, values.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: source_operator_id and facility_id are bounded-length string fields.

requirements.summary: MaterialDNA.classification.ewc_code and waste_framework_code carry Green/Amber list and EWC-derived classification for shipment procedures.
requirements.rationale: See docs/category-classification-mapping.md for candidate EWC chapters per LOOP category; this document does not validate a specific 6-digit EWC entry, which depends on a material's actual origin and process history.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: ewc_code pattern validation (two-digit groups separated by single spaces).

requirements.summary: traceability.retention_until carries the asserted retention window (WSR's confirmed minimum: 5 years from the recovery/disposal completion certificate date).
requirements.rationale: See docs/retention-and-evidence-guidance.md — this is a plain data field the emitting node asserts; LOOP does not enforce it.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: retention_until is a date-time formatted field.

requirements.summary: A Transfer with waste_shipment_doc_ref set should not be marked passport.visible_to: public, since DIWASS has no public access tier at all.
requirements.rationale: docs/access-scope-model.md documents DIWASS's real access model (authenticated operators and competent authorities only) as mapping most directly to this model's operator/regulator tiers, explicitly excluding public.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: semantic check that waste_shipment_doc_ref presence plus passport.visible_to=public is rejected; absence of passport, or visible_to=operator/regulator, must remain valid.

requirements.summary: passport.supported_regimes includes "waste-shipment" to mark a MaterialDNA/ProductDNA record as Waste Shipment Regulation-relevant.
requirements.rationale: Gives federation peers a consistent hint without implying a DIWASS/TRACES NT API integration.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: supported_regimes only accepts its five enum values.
